content_sections.heading: About CCSID
content_sections.text: CCSID is a multidisciplinary centre of the Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibpur, Howrah 711 103. It was set up in 2025 with an endowment from an alumnus of the Institute. Faculty members from the Engineering, Science, Management and Humanities departments can be associated with the Centre for research, training and education.

content_sections.heading: IIEST CCSID Chair Professor and Adjunct Associate/Assistant Professor Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The notice does not fix how many positions go to each level. The expert committee will recommend whether the two positions are filled at the Chair Professor level, the Adjunct Associate/Assistant Professor level, or both. The Centre wants multidisciplinary research in sustainability and technological innovation. It places particular emphasis on: Clean energy systems and next-generation energy storage with transmission Carbon Capture, Utilization, and Storage (CCUS) technologies Smart, Clean & Green Campus Sustainable Materials Disaster Mitigation and Adaptation Sustainable Transportation Green Buildings Frugal Revolution Biodiversity and Nature-based Solutions Steer the Centre's research activities in its focus areas Cultivate partnerships with academic, government and industry stakeholders Develop proposals to get external grants Cultivate academia-industry collaboration for skill development and training, research, innovation, consultancy and entrepreneurship Help build a vibrant research team by promoting a culture of research excellence and innovation Organise seminars, workshops and awareness programmes on a regular basis Undertake any other activities aligned with the objectives of the Centre FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: IIEST CCSID Chair Professor and Adjunct Associate/Assistant Professor Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Eligibility depends on the applicant's current position at IIEST Shibpur: All applicants also need: A brilliant research record with proven recognition Proven success in securing competitive research funding Expertise in the Centre's research focus areas Strong communication, networking and team-building skills The ability to spend reasonable time at the Centre while still carrying out their duties in the parent department For the full eligibility of each post, see the official notification.

rows.who_is_eligible: A Professor from any Department of IIEST Shibpur
An Associate/Assistant Professor from any Department of IIEST Shibpur

content_sections.heading: Recognition and Benefits
content_sections.text: The designation of Chair Professor or Adjunct Associate/Assistant Professor The chance to lead multidisciplinary research Dedicated building space for the Centre's activities Use of the available endowment for research, travel, conducting workshops and similar work A monthly honorarium paid on top of regular salary: Rs. 30,000 for a Chair Professor and Rs. 20,000 for an Adjunct Associate/Assistant Professor

rows.event: Last date for receipt of applications
rows.date: 14 days from the date of publication on the Institute website (11.11.2026, counted from the notice date of 28.10.2026)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: An expert committee will make the selection. Applicants may be asked to interact with the committee. The committee's recommendation decides whether the two positions are filled at the Chair Professor level, the Adjunct Associate/Assistant Professor level, or both.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The tenure is initially 3 years, with an annual appraisal. Either party (the faculty member or the Centre) may end the association with 90 days' prior written notice. Selected faculty keep their responsibilities in their parent department while working with the Centre.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIEST CCSID Chair Professor and Adjunct Associate/Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed CV with your ORCID link. Write a cover letter and send it through your Head of the Department. Scan the forwarded letter. Write a plan of research and development activities in the Centre's focus areas. Combine the CV, the scanned cover letter and the research plan into a single PDF. Email the PDF to [email protected] , with a copy to [email protected] . Send it so that it arrives within 14 days of the notice's publication on the Institute website. Documents in the single PDF: Detailed CV with ORCID link Scanned cover letter, forwarded through the Head of the Department Plan of research and development activities in the Centre's focus areas

faq.question: Q1. Can someone from outside IIEST Shibpur apply?
faq.answer: No. Only regular faculty members of IIEST Shibpur can apply. Professors are eligible for Chair Professor, and Associate/Assistant Professors for the adjunct post.

faq.question: Q2. How much is the honorarium?
faq.answer: A Chair Professor gets Rs. 30,000 a month and an Adjunct Associate/Assistant Professor gets Rs. 20,000 a month. Both amounts are a top-up.

faq.question: Q3. How many positions go to each level?
faq.answer: The notice does not fix a split. The two positions will be filled at either or both levels, depending on what the expert committee recommends.

faq.question: Q4. Which email address should the application go to?
faq.answer: Send it to [email protected], with a copy to [email protected]. Questions can go to the same two addresses.

faq.question: Q5. Does the cover letter need the Head of Department's approval?
faq.answer: Yes. The cover letter must be sent through the Head of the Department. Attach a scanned copy of it to the single PDF.

faq.question: Q6. What should the research plan cover?
faq.answer: It should set out your planned research and development activities in the Centre's focus areas. These include CCUS technologies, green buildings, sustainable transportation, and disaster mitigation and adaptation.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the tenure?
faq.answer: The tenure is initially 3 years, with an annual appraisal. Either side can end it with 90 days' prior written notice.

faq.question: Q8. Will there be an interview?
faq.answer: An expert committee makes the selection, and applicants may be asked to interact with it.

faq.question: Q9. Do selected faculty leave their department?
faq.answer: No. They are expected to spend reasonable time at the Centre while still carrying out their responsibilities in their parent department.
